headline: Pertamax & Non-Subsidized Fuel Prices Fall, Bahlil: Following World Market
summary: Indonesia's energy minister Bahlil Lahadalia responded to a decline in non-subsidised fuel prices, including Pertamax. He said the changes follow the world market.
why: Non-subsidised fuel prices in Indonesia track global crude and refined product prices, affecting fuel costs for consumers and state-owned Pertamina.
